name: Lexi
long_description:
Lexi is an AI operating system for legal teams, law firms, and in-house counsel. It brings legal research, drafting, document review, contract redlining, case workflows, translation, knowledge management, and AI associates into one secure platform.

Lexi is built for enterprise legal work with end-to-end security, role-based access controls, audit trails, encrypted document handling, private workspaces, and deployment options for sensitive legal environments. Legal teams use Lexi to process high-volume legal documents, find answers with verified citations, draft in their preferred style, review contracts, and manage legal workflows from intake to output.

Lexi has processed 5,000,000+ documents across 200,000+ cases for 200+ organizations and law firms, helping lawyers save 10+ hours every week and handle more matters without adding headcount.
one_liner: AI Operating System for Legal Teams
